Usage: jsn <command> [options]

Command-line interface for ServiceNow


CORE
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  jsn knowledge       Search and read knowledge articles through the Knowledge API (kb)
  jsn incidents       Manage incidents (e.g. "incidents list --query priority=1") (incident)
  jsn changes         Manage changes (e.g. "changes list --query priority=1") (change_request)
  jsn requests        Manage requests (e.g. "requests list --query priority=1") (sc_req_item)
  jsn tasks           Manage tasks (e.g. "tasks list --query priority=1") (sc_task)
  jsn tickets         Query generic tickets (e.g. "tickets list --query active=true") (ticket)
  jsn approvals       Manage approval requests (list, approve, reject, submit, history)

AUTOMATION
──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ── Async ──
  jsn flows           Manage Flow Designer flows (flow)
  jsn actions         Flow Designer actions: create, edit full definitions, and test with outputs (action)
  jsn scriptactions   Manage scriptactions (e.g. "scriptactions list --query nameLIKEincident") (scriptaction)
  jsn scheduledjobs   Manage scheduledjobs (e.g. "scheduledjobs list --query nameLIKEincident") (scheduledjob)
  jsn triggers        Manage triggers (e.g. "triggers list --query nameLIKEincident") (trigger)
  jsn asyncrules      Manage asyncrules (e.g. "asyncrules list --query nameLIKEincident") (asyncrule)

  ── In Memory ──
  jsn rules           Manage rules (e.g. "rules list --query nameLIKEincident") (rule)
  jsn decisiontables  Manage decision tables (decisiontable)
  jsn assignments     Manage assignments (e.g. "assignments list --query nameLIKEincident") (assignment)

  ── Inbound ──
  jsn scrapi          Manage Scripted REST APIs (list/show operations, create full APIs with resources) (scripted-rest)
  jsn email           Manage email (e.g. "email list --query nameLIKEincident") (emails)

  ── Outbound ──
  jsn restmessage     Manage restmessage (e.g. "restmessage list --query nameLIKEincident") (rm)
  jsn soapmessages    Manage soapmessages (e.g. "soapmessages list --query nameLIKEincident") (soapmsg)

ACCESS
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  jsn acls            Manage acls (e.g. "acls list --query nameLIKEincident") (acl)
  jsn b4rules         Inspect before-query business rules that can filter record reads (b4rule)
  jsn roles           Manage roles (e.g. "roles list --query nameLIKEincident") (role)
  jsn privileges      Manage privileges (e.g. "privileges list --query nameLIKEincident") (privilege)
  jsn aliases         Manage aliases (e.g. "aliases list --query nameLIKEincident") (alias)
  jsn groups          Manage ServiceNow groups (group)
  jsn groupmembers    Manage group memberships (groupmember)
  jsn grouproles      Manage group roles (grouprole)
  jsn users           Manage ServiceNow users (user)

USER EXPERIENCE
──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ── Shared (across all experiences) ──
  jsn forms           Manage UI Forms (form)
  jsn lists           List views for a table (list-layout)
  jsn clientscripts   Manage clientscripts (e.g. "clientscripts list --query nameLIKEincident") (clientscript)
  jsn uipolicies      Manage uipolicies (e.g. "uipolicies list --query nameLIKEincident") (uipolicy)
  jsn uiactions       Manage uiactions (e.g. "uiactions list --query nameLIKEincident") (uiaction)
  jsn views           Manage views (e.g. "views list --query nameLIKEincident") (view)
  jsn catalogitems    Manage Service Catalog items (ci)
  jsn catalogscripts  Manage catalogscripts (e.g. "catalogscripts list --query nameLIKEincident") (catalogscript)
  jsn cataloguipoliciesManage cataloguipolicies (e.g. "cataloguipolicies list --query nameLIKEincident") (cataloguipolicy)

  ── Core UI ──
  jsn uipages         Manage uipages (e.g. "uipages list --query nameLIKEincident") (ui-page)
  jsn uimacros        Manage uimacros (e.g. "uimacros list --query nameLIKEincident") (uimacro)
  jsn listcontrols    Manage listcontrols (e.g. "listcontrols list --query nameLIKEincident") (listcontrol)

  ── Service Portal ──
  jsn sppages         Manage sppages (e.g. "sppages list --query nameLIKEincident") (sp-pages)
  jsn spwidgets       Manage spwidgets (e.g. "spwidgets list --query nameLIKEincident") (sp-widget)

  ── Next Experience (Workspaces) ──
  jsn uxscripts       Manage uxscripts (e.g. "uxscripts list --query nameLIKEincident") (uxscript)
  jsn uxlists         Manage uxlists (e.g. "uxlists list --query nameLIKEincident") (uxlist)
  jsn uxapplicability Manage uxapplicability (e.g. "uxapplicability list --query nameLIKEincident") (uxapp)

  ── Navigation ──
  jsn appmenu         Manage appmenu (e.g. "appmenu list --query nameLIKEincident") (app-menu)
  jsn appmodules      Manage appmodules (e.g. "appmodules list --query nameLIKEincident") (appmodule)

DATA
──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ── DB Schema ──
  jsn tables          Manage tables (e.g. "tables list --query nameLIKEincident") (table)
  jsn columns         Manage columns (e.g. "columns list --query nameLIKEincident") (column)
  jsn relationships   Manage relationships (e.g. "relationships list --query nameLIKEincident") (relationship)
  jsn cmdb            Query the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) — CIs and relationship traversal (read-only)

  ── Shared Code, Transforms, Logs ──
  jsn includes        Manage includes (e.g. "includes list --query nameLIKEincident") (include)
  jsn import          Manage import (e.g. "import list --query nameLIKEincident") (imports)
  jsn logs            Query system logs (log)
  jsn properties      Manage properties (e.g. "properties list --query nameLIKEincident") (property)
  jsn records         Query and manage records in any table (e.g. "records list --table incident --query priority=1")
  jsn transactions    Summarize syslog_transaction response times by transaction type
  jsn snippets        Save and re-run named query snippets (stored locally, no instance contact except run)

CONFIGURATION
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  jsn setup           Set up JSN defaults and manage ServiceNow connections (interactive)
  jsn auth            Manage authentication (OAuth, Basic, or browser session)
  jsn updatesets      Manage update sets. Global + Default mutations require approval (--force only after user approval); create/set remain available to select a dedicated capture set. Scope mismatches warn; completed capture sets block writes. (updateset)
  jsn scopes          Manage application scopes (scope)
  jsn midservers      Manage ServiceNow MID Servers and run commands through them (midserver)
  jsn platform        Inspect read-only platform health and node statistics
  jsn completion      Generate shell completion script

DEVELOPER
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  jsn scan            Instance Scan checks, suites, explicit targets, progress and findings
  jsn atf             Automated Test Framework (list, suites, run, results)
  jsn eval            Execute background scripts on the instance (--repl for interactive mode)
  jsn rest            Make raw REST API calls
  jsn graphql         Execute a GraphQL document against ServiceNow Now GraphQL
  jsn codesearch      Search code across ServiceNow artifacts (script includes, business rules, client scripts, ...)
  jsn docs            Search ServiceNow documentation (hosted by default; configure your service in setup)
  jsn diff            Compare records across configured profiles (read-only)
  jsn perf            Capture and compare read-only ServiceNow performance summaries (performance)
  jsn skill           Manage the jsn AI agent skill file (for Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)
  jsn version         Show version information

MORE
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  jsn cases           List, show or search service and HR cases visible to the connected account (case)
  jsn attachments     List, download and upload files attached to any record (attachment)
  jsn store           Discover ServiceNow Store applications, inspect versions and entitlement, and request explicit installs/updates
  jsn skipped-updates Review and process existing unresolved skipped updates across all upgrade history
  jsn history         Local seven-day mutation history (not a durable ServiceNow audit)
  jsn customizations  Capture and compare read-only customization evidence locally
  jsn upgrade         Upgrade jsn through npm (preserves the installed release channel) (update)
  jsn discover        Find commands by words in their names, aliases, descriptions, or configured table


FLAGS
  --all-commands          Show the full command list, including admin and developer tools [boolean]
  --reason                Optional non-sensitive reason saved in local mutation history [string]
  --force                 Approve Global + Default mutation context only after user approval; delete commands also use this for their separate confirmation [boolean]
  -i, --instance          ServiceNow instance URL [string]
  -p, --profile           Configuration profile to use [string]
  --format                Output format: auto, json, markdown, styled, quiet, csv [string: auto, json, markdown, styled, quiet, csv]
  --json                  Output in JSON format (shortcut for --format=json) [boolean]
  --csv                   Output in CSV format (shortcut for --format=csv) [boolean]
  --get                   Extract a JSON path from the output envelope (e.g. --get "data.records.0.number"); no jq needed [string]
  -q, --quiet             Output only data, no envelope (shortcut for --format=quiet) [boolean]
  --styled                Force styled output even when piped [boolean]
  --markdown              Output in Markdown table format [boolean]
  --help                  Show help [boolean]

TIPS
  Show every command, including admin and developer tools: "jsn --all-commands --help"
  Command visibility follows the selected profile at authentication; explicit commands still use ServiceNow ACLs.
  Find commands by task words: "jsn discover catalog"; by configured table: "jsn discover --table incident"
  Cross-table task searches and custom tables: "jsn records list --help"
  Specialized commands offer configured columns, lookup, and table-specific views; inspect discovery results for details
  Raw endpoints when needed: "jsn rest --help"; examples and intent guidance: "jsn discover --help"
  Use "jsn <command> --help" for details, or "jsn <command> list --help" for list options
  "jsn --json" prints the registered command surface as JSON for scripts and agents

LEARN MORE
  Some list commands offer a picker in an interactive terminal with automatic output.
  Arrow keys browse (10 visible items); type to search; scroll to load more; Enter selects; Esc cancels.
  Picker eligibility and search fields vary by command. Explicit output formats (including --json) skip pickers.
  Use "jsn <command> --help" for more information about a command.
